page.layout: Running head at top: "ANTIDOTUM", with "Cap.12." at the right. Printed page number "106" at the top left. One text column with a centred italic title above the new section. One marginal note in the left margin beside the line "piusque inculcant". No notes in the right margin. No catchword or signature below the text.

main_text.p: situm[?] Dominum nostrum. Ratio nostra haec est: Si eadem essent ratio Meriti de Condigno bonorum ad [illegible, ~10 letters], quae est [?] ad aeternam mortem; Apostolus non ex destinato mutasset formulam loquendi, vocando mortem aeternam, stipendium peccati, vitam autem aeternam χάρισμα[?], Gratiam, vel Donum gratia. Hic pugio[?] in causa ipsius visceribus inhaeret. Interpretationem hujus loci Antiquitatis patrocinio permittamus.

head.i: Patrum antiquorum communis interpretatio Pontificiorum glossematis repugnans.

main_text.head: SECTIO III[?].
main_text.p: Sed dum hoc ostendere conamur, Adversarii nos interpellant interturbantque objectione illa[?] ex Augustino, qui, ne nobis nimis sit mora, audiendus primum, dein[?] concedendus[?] est nobis. Locus quem saepe ipsi piusque inculcant{1}, hic est: Vide (inquit) quam vigilanter Apostolus verba posuerit, STIPENDIUM PECCATI MORS. Quis non consequentum[?] & congruentissime addere iudicaret, STIPENDIUM JUSTITIÆ VITA ÆTERNA. Et verum est, sicut peccati merito redditur mors, ita merito justitia tanquam stipendium redditur vita aeterna. Haec ille. Ita, inquiet[?], & quidem verissime. Nam si eventum spectemus, aeque Deus bonos ac malos remune-Augst. epist.105. ad Sixtum.

page.notes: Page top: the first word is cut at the edge of the scan, so "situm" is a fragment and is marked [?]. The overprinted lines 2 and 3 of the first paragraph are blurred and partly overlaid by a strike-through; the illegible part is marked. The Greek word χάρισμα is blurred. The section number "III" is overprinted and uncertain. Several words in the body (objectione illa, dein, concedendus, consequentum, inquiet) are doubtful and marked [?]. The running head omits the chapter number "Cap.12.". The note mark "1" is placed at the probable point in the text. The text ends with the hyphenated word "remune-" at the foot of the column.
